## Code review: spaces tables unified on PaginatedDataTable

This was a full review of `682bd0ecd…HEAD`, but with two shortcuts. I ran all nine review areas myself instead of as nine separate agents. Only the four behavioural findings were checked by a pair of agents (one trying to prove each, one trying to disprove it). Nothing was edited, installed, run or posted.

9 files, +523 −301 · base 682bd0e (merge-base 7d1ccd5) → HEAD 3e3e650 · all changes are committed
Repo: Safe{Wallet} web, TypeScript/React, Jest, 9 of 9 areas have code to review

| | |
|---|---|
| **Verdict** | Fine to open the PR. Fixing #1 and #2 first is worth it: both are small and users would notice them. |
| **Score** | About 90/100 (4 of 9 findings checked by both agents, all 4 held up) |
| **Held down by** | Two behaviour regressions: the Team table jumps back to page 1 after actions, and long address book names can no longer be read in full |
| **Fix first** | #1: page reset on refetch |

### Scores by area, worst first
| Area | Score | Findings |
|---|---|---|
| Regression | 80 | #1, #2 |
| Testing | 88 | #6, #7 |
| Bugs | 90 | #3, #4 |
| Conventions | 94 | #8 |
| Performance | 95 | #5 |
| Security, Architecture, DRY, KISS | 100 | nothing filed (tidy-ups below) |

### Findings

**#1 · P2 · Regression: the Team table jumps back to page 1 after every admin action** · checked by both agents, holds
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:67`
- **What:** `useEffect(() => setPage(0), [rows])` resets the page whenever the `rows` array is a new object.
- **Why:** The role update, remove and renew mutations each clear the cache tag the members query uses (`invalidatesTags: ['spaces']` in `packages/store/.../spaces.ts:172,192,204`). That refetch builds a new `members` array, so `useSpaceMembersByStatus` returns new arrays and the effect fires.
- **Scenario:** A space has more than 25 members. An admin on page 2 edits someone's role and lands back on page 1. The old `EnhancedTable` never reset the page when the data changed.
- **Fix:** Only reset when the set of rows actually changes, for example by comparing `getRowKey` values or passing an explicit `resetKey` such as the search query. The existing page clamp at line 91 already stops a shrinking list from leaving the user on an empty page.

**#2 · P2 · Regression: long address book names can't be read in full any more** · checked by both agents, holds
`apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:66`
- **What:** Commit 7f34d71ca removed the name tooltip as "redundant", but the name is still cut off (`truncate` in a `table-fixed` table with a `w-[20%]` column).
- **Scenario:** A contact with a long name shows as "Treasury multisig for…". There is no tooltip and no `title` attribute, so the full name appears nowhere.
- **Fix:** Put the tooltip back, using the same truncate + Tooltip pattern this diff keeps for the email cell at `MembersList/index.tsx:115-121`.

| # | P | Area | Location | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | P3 | Bugs | `PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:41` | Sorting compares strings with raw `<` and `>`, so it is case-sensitive: "alice" sorts after "Zoe", and checksummed addresses sort by character code. The old `EnhancedTable` did the same for members, but the address book had no sorting before, so this is new there. Use `localeCompare(…, { sensitivity: 'base' })`. Checked by both agents, holds. |
| 4 | P3 | Bugs | `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:46` | The "Added by" column sorts by the raw `createdBy` address or email. The cell shows the name that `EthHashInfo onlyName` looks up, so the sorted order doesn't match what users see. Checked by both agents, holds. |
| 5 | P3 | Performance | `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:36` | `columns` is rebuilt on every render. Because it is in the dependency list of `sortedRows`'s `useMemo` (`PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:87`), the whole list is sorted again on every render. Wrap it in `useMemo([hasMiddleColumn, showAddedBy])`. |
| 6 | P3 | Testing | `MembersList/index.test.tsx:97` | The test that hovered the email and checked the tooltip content was cut down to checking for a `truncate` class. Nothing tests the tooltip any more. |
| 7 | P3 | Testing | `SpaceAddressBook/__tests__/SpaceAddressBookTable.test.tsx` | The new sort columns in the address book (name, address, chain count, "Added by") and in the members table have no tests. Reverting any of those `sortValue` functions would not fail a test. |
| 8 | P3 | Conventions | `PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:1` | This new component has no Storybook story. `apps/web/AGENTS.md:10` and `:160` require one for a new component. |

### What this review did not cover
- No tests, type-check or build were run (read-only review), and nothing was checked in a browser.
- Findings #5 to #8 were not independently checked; I verified them directly in the code.
- I didn't look at how the new `shadcn-scope` wrapper in `Members/index.tsx:27` looks in dark mode or inside the MUI `AddMemberModal`. It follows the same wrapper pattern as `SpaceAddressBook/index.tsx:120`.

### Worth tidying (no score impact)
1. `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:44-47`: the "Last updated" sort branch never runs, because nothing in `apps/web/src` passes `showLastUpdated`. Its value `updatedAt || createdAt` would also be `''` for local contacts, and those would sort first instead of last.
2. `PaginatedDataTable/index.tsx:142-156`: the previous and next buttons have icons only and no `aria-label` (carried over from the old table).
3. `components/ui/pagination.tsx` already exists; the hand-built previous/next footer could reuse it.

Left alone on purpose: a manual sort now overrides the "duplicates at the bottom" order in My contacts. Clearing the sort brings that order back, so it is working as designed.

### Checked and ruled out
- The address book's row key `entry.address` is unchanged from before.
- `MembersList`'s `columns` list is defined once at module level, so #5 doesn't apply there.
- Page clamping prevents an empty page when the list shrinks.

Nothing was posted anywhere. Tell me if you want any of #1 to #8 or the tidy-ups fixed, or drafted as tickets.
